fib.desc: Iterative Fibonacci with a parallel swap. Good for seeing tuple assignment and how each language handles integer overflow.

gcd.desc: Greatest common divisor with a while loop. Shows how % behaves differently on negative numbers.

fact.desc: Recursive factorial. Tests recursion and how quickly each target overflows.

prime.desc: Trial division up to the square root. Loops, early returns and boolean results.

power.desc: Exponentiation by squaring. Recursion with integer division.

digits.desc: Repeated % 10 and // 10. Shows how integer division is written in each language.

bubble.desc: Sorts a list in place. Arrays, nested loops and index swaps.

bsearch.desc: Halving search on a sorted list. Integer division and while loops.

reverse.desc: Builds a reversed string. String indexing and concatenation across languages.

stats.desc: Mean and standard deviation of a list. Floats, math.sqrt and rounding in every language.

palindrome.desc: Ignores case and punctuation, then checks a word or phrase from both ends. String methods and character tests.

matrix.desc: Builds a rows × cols grid of products, then adds every cell. Nested lists in each language: list comprehensions, vectors of vectors, C structs.

stack.desc: Pushes positive numbers and pops on zero, then prints what is left. Growable lists: append and pop, ArrayList, Vec, C helper structs.

words.desc: Counts each word with a dictionary and reports the most frequent one (ties go to the alphabetically first). Maps in every language: dict, LinkedHashMap, Map, Go maps, BTreeMap, and C helper structs.

input.desc: Reads a name and a line of numbers from standard input, then greets and prints their sum and maximum. Edit the stdin box in Run & test to try your own input.
